tagline.zh: 这周干了啥？让 Qoder 帮你想想
tagline.en: What did you do this week? Let Qoder remember for you

story.zh: 周五下午五点，老板要周报。你翻了翻这周的记录 notes.md：修了一个 bug，开了四个会，剩下的时间不太方便说。
story.en: Friday, 5pm, the boss wants a weekly report. You open this week's notes.md: one bug fixed, four meetings attended, and the rest is hard to put in writing.

goal.zh: 让 Qoder 把流水账写成一份体面的周报 WEEKLY.md。不许编造没干过的事，也不许出现「摸鱼」。
goal.en: Have Qoder turn the notes into a respectable WEEKLY.md. No inventing work that never happened, and no mention of slacking.

openingPrompt.zh: 读一下 notes.md，这是我这周的真实记录。先用一句话评价我这周的工作状态，要毒舌。先别写周报
openingPrompt.en: Read notes.md, my honest log of the week. First sum up my work ethic in one savage sentence. Don't write the report yet

hint.en: Press Enter and face the verdict.

prompt.zh: 帮我写成一份体面的周报存到 WEEKLY.md：分「本周进展、问题与风险、下周计划」三段，用职场话术包装，但每一条都要能在 notes.md 里找到出处，不许出现摸鱼、刷剧这类词
prompt.en: Turn it into a respectable weekly report in WEEKLY.md with three sections: Progress, Risks, Next Week. Use corporate language, but every line must trace back to something in notes.md, and words like slacking or binge-watching must not appear

hint.en: See how good the spin really is.

prompt.zh: 另外写一个 TRUTH.md 对照表：左边是周报里的说法，右边是 notes.md 里的真相
prompt.en: Also write TRUTH.md, a table with what the report says on the left and what notes.md actually says on the right

label.en: It has a plan for next week
The report doesn't give you away
